messages:
Marina: Heads up — opened a PR to overhaul the mini-quickstart tutorial for the tiny hello app. Main changes: replace legacy SDK auth snippet with SDKv4 pattern, tighten env var guidance, and add a short smoke test. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/412
Alex: thanks! can you paste the old vs new auth snippets here so I can sanity-check the migration notes?
Marina: old: `const client = new RedwoodClient(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY)`
Marina: new: `import { Redwood } from '@redwood/sdk'; const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });`
Sam: quick note — runtime team prefers `REDWOOD_API_KEY` naming (matches infra). thx for switching.
Taylor: does this change affect the quickstart Docker example? we should keep parity.
Marina: yes — updated the Dockerfile section to show env var export and `--env-file` example. sample snippet: `ENV_FILE=.env && docker run --env-file $ENV_FILE hello-minima`
Jess: QA caught a failing link in the tutorial (old `GET /v1/auth` reference). I left a comment on the PR.
Marina: saw it, fixed in latest commit. Also added a short troubleshooting note for 401s (common mis-set env name).
Alex: CI shows a lint error in the markdown (heading levels). I'll patch in a follow-up commit unless someone objects. :+1:
Sam: go ahead, Alex — fine with eng. if you can also add a one-liner about token scopes that would help teams.
Marina: added the token scope line: "For quickstart, a key with read/generate scope is sufficient."
ci-bot: build/test status — docs-md-lint: failed (line 42 header depth)
Alex: fixed header depth and aligned codeblock language tags. pushed.
ci-bot: build/test status — docs-md-lint: passed; link-check: passed; preview-deploy: queued
Taylor: can we ask Solutions to smoke the updated quickstart in a fresh account? want to avoid regressions during onboarding sprint.
Jess: I can run the smoke test tomorrow AM and paste results here.
Marina: thanks — tagging @Jess. Also request: can someone from DevEx review the CLI auth example? I changed the CLI flags syntax.
Alex: will review after stand. quick comment: use `redwood login --api-key $KEY` in examples, consistent with CLI v2.
Marina: updated CLI snippet and added note about how to revoke keys in Console.
Sam: small nit — the model name used in the example is `mini-alpha-1`. Could we use `redwood/minima` instead? matches catalog.
Marina: swapped to `redwood/minima`.
Taylor: timeline? when can this land?
Marina: aim to merge today after Jess' smoke test and Alex signoff. if all green, I'll merge and cherry-pick to the stable branch.
Jess: smoke test done — quickstart boots, auth works, example generation succeeds. logged two tiny copy nits (typo in params table).
Marina: fixed the copy nits and pushed. thanks Jess.
Alex: LGTM from DevEx.
Sam: approved from eng.
ci-bot: preview-deploy: successful — preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood/mini-quickstart/2467129012
Marina: merging now. will follow up with a short release note for the docs changelog. :tada:
Taylor: sweet. can you also add a one-line in the onboarding checklist to update the quickstart when SDKs change? ticket me if you need a formal card.
Marina: noted — will open a follow-up ticket. thanks everyone.
